scene_context_seed.runtime_note: CAMP PRESENTATION: Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren, and Maevra may all be present as field models around camp. Maevra's arm remains splinted from the Broken Convoy attack. C03/C04/C05 use the current rehearsal-first production drafts. C03 includes all four and Torren's post-meal smoking. C04 is a Cyanis/Torren modern-map scene. C05 is Ilyra + Maevra only: Ilyra changes the splint, uses restrained magic only for pain/strain relief, and asks about Maevra and Torren. The broken bone is not magically repaired. OPTIONAL BACKTRACK: leaving camp for Southern Briar returns to Cyanis-only ordinary traversal. REST: optional content may be skipped; choosing rest advances to morning. HARD FIREWALL: no Prime, Last Sentinel, bearer, Entity, or complete ancient-network answers.

required_story_beats: Junction-area camp functions as the safe Chapter-1 cleanup hub.
Party members may be visible as field models around camp.
Maevra's splinted arm remains visible through the cleanup window.
C03, C04, and C05 are optional and do not advance the chapter independently.
C03 may include Torren's ordinary post-meal smoking only after everyone has finished eating.
C05 is private to Ilyra and Maevra and may maintain the broken arm through a splint change and limited pain-easing magic while opening their adult friendship and Maevra/Torren history.
The player may backtrack into Southern Briar and use the earlier overgrown side access for the optional Cistern Devourer Hunt.
Choosing rest closes the cleanup window and advances to the next morning.
The party departs toward already-planned Dunmere.
Ordinary wilderness traversal after departure returns to Cyanis-only field presentation.
